author: SunnyD
text_post: FR: Paris Ok so I went to Paris, France for the holiday and I must say sarging in different culture's where English isn't the primary language is a challenge. So the first day we were there me and my wing were trying to do a little day sarging but we weren't having any luck, whole language barrier and everything was a major set back. So we went to this bar called "The Buda Bar" and I opened up a set 3 british women hb 6,6,7. About 5 minutes in the set my wing joins me and throws interference on the two 6's using the best friend test, I isolated the 7 and after about 5mins and a few shots later, which she bought I kiss closed. Tired from the flight we left the bar and went back to the hotel.  The next day we woke up saw the sites and everything tried to do a little day sarging but for some damn reason we had no luck sarging french women during the day!!! Cursed I guess! That night we hit up this bar called "The Drunken Frog" Irish type pub very crowded and loud music with a dance floor. For some reason Paris has a lot of Irish Pubs. Through trial and error I finally found my nitch on how to get passed the whole language barrier. Most of the women I met knew a few english words like: hello, goodbye, thank you etc.... Basically that's all I know in French so I used this as a way to establish a connection with these women. I started approaching women and basically just smiling and trying to speak french,used good body language, and carried myself in a positive way. I think it was said only 7% of attraction is spoken verbally and I am now a firm believer of that percentage. I was opening up sets by smiling and speaking English or jokingly trying to say something in French which would make them laugh, and leading them out to the dance floor. I think dancing was the sealing point, it's something universal and mad kino was going on and it enabled me to kiss close with women who I hadn't spoke more than 5 words that they could understand.  Day 3 We ate lunch at this Cafe downtown and we met this waitress who actually spoke pretty good english. I used a lot of C&F stuff with her she was really open and I asked her where's the good clubs/bars were around here. She went on to name some I said "Well that's a lot of bars and I have no idea where to go in this city and we will get lost we need a tour guide to show us around" She looked at me with no expression at first, and I was thinking in my head "shit that line didn't work worth a shit did it". She then smiled and asked us what hotel we were staying at we gave her the name and number of the place we were staying at and she said she would call us if her and a few friends were going to hang out. Ya I know never give your number out to a women right go for the close, but in this case I don't have a number and this was the only way to have another possible meeting, I wasn't expecting anything to come from this. We got back to the hotel at about 8pm had a message it was from the hb waitress. She left her number which sounded more like an ip address than a phone number.  Hb waitress picks me and my wing up around 10, she brought 3 other people with her hb 4 and a hb8, and another dude who didn't seem to like the fact we were going out with them at first. So we crammed into the small ass car she had and let me tell you french people are the craziest drivers I have ever known, I thought hb waitress was going to kill us cutting people off and honking her horn. After about a 15min carnival ride in the car we reached this bar called something berdaux or something like that, I can't remember something with a french name! It was a cool bar it reminded me of Axis almost. From the start my wing seemed to be connecting and working hb waitress pretty well because after about 10min of being there he had here isolated on a couch in the corner. First thing I did was ignore hb8 and was really friendly with hb4, who was so annoying and her english was really bad so it gave me a headache. The guy spoke pretty good english so I bs'd with him for about 5mins and he finally started being pretty friendly. Then hb4 dragged my ass out on the dance floor right as I was finally going to transition to hb8 who I had been neglecting talking to her 2 friends. So after about 5 mins I broke the french death grip hb4 had on me and went back to the guy and hb8. Hb8 was now talking to another guy who had just bought her a drink and the guy was just standing next to them both. I came up to them telling them that hb4 was a crazy psycho dancer (in a joking manner). I was going to try to use a AMOG killer but the guy talking to hb8 didn't speak english so I sat there for a sec saying to myself how the hell do you AMOG someone who can't understand you? Then it hit me I told hb4 go drag that guy to the dance floor, being the nut job she was she basically carried the AMOG to the dance floor. I then went in for the kill threw a lot of basic routines, then hb4 grabbed their guy friend and started dancing with him. I then isolated hb8 to a couch right near my wing who was going at it with hb waitress for the last 30mins. I ended up kiss closing with hb8 at the club.  Hb waitress was to drunk to drive as were the rest of us so she left her car at the club and me, my wing, hb waitress, hb 8 went back to the hotel by taking the metro rail and took a nice dip in the hot tub, which was inside thank god since it was colder than shit out! These 2 women were pretty wild when they were drunk, because before I knew it we had dared them to take their tops off and it was like it was nothing to them. I guess different cultures have different sexual ok's. Right when things got interesting one of the hotel managers or whatever the hell that douche bag was said we needed to leave the hot tub and if whoever wasn't a guest here needs to leave. So hb waitress and hb8 were practically escorted out of the hotel and went went back to our rooms. Death to hotel managers!!!! All in all we met up with those 2 girls the next two nights had shit loads of fun and fuck closed them both, kudos I love France!!
